note: Machine-readable source of truth for learn's component class strings, validated against designs/learn/index.html by scripts/check.mjs. learn is friendly and chunky: rounded-xl, border-2 fields, a soft focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/10, font-semibold buttons with shadow-md that lift to shadow-lg. Form controls are styled native inputs (peer/checked:). Values are Tailwind utility classes routed through the tokens in shared/TOKENS.md.

button.base: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

variant.default: bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-md transition-all hover:bg-primary/90 hover:shadow-lg
variant.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground shadow-md transition-all hover:bg-destructive/90 hover:shadow-lg
variant.outline: border-2 border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground hover:border-accent

button.docs: Rounded-xl, font-semibold. default/destructive use transition-all so their shadow lifts on hover (shadow-md -> shadow-lg). sm tightens the radius to rounded-lg. link is padding/height-less (cn()/tailwind-merge drops the size padding).

statusPill.docs: Tinted /10 fill with the status colour as text; a leading dot repeats it. The status word is in the text.

avatar.docs: Initials on bg-muted are the fallback — no per-user generated colours. Group avatars overlap with -space-x-2 and each carries groupRing to punch the overlap.

pagination.docs: Current page is outlined (linkActive), not filled — a filled page number reads as a primary action.

progress.docs: Width is data-driven (the indicator's inline width, or a translateX in the Radix component). Ring and skeleton variants live in the same section but are their own primitives.

skeleton.docs: A pulsing muted block. Callers set width/height and rounded-full for an avatar placeholder.
